answer.rationale: Primary expires in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line is at 94% with no buffer, so a full primary switch would meet the 18% spend cut but would raise delivery risk. Incumbent continuity has previously avoided migration and delivery interruption; renegotiation at renewal has previously moved price and terms when benchmarked. Intend to use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to push the incumbent toward the mandate while keeping the current source. Unverified whether prior low-cost onboarding would be safe on this timeline, or whether renegotiation can actually reach 18%. Deferral and second-source do not solve the expiring primary. Verification of c2 and c4 before lock-in.
